datasets.title: Copernicus Emergency Management Service - Mapping (CEMS) - Rapid mapping per event
datasets.description: This service consists of the on-demand and fast provision (hours-days) of geospatial information in support of emergency management activities immediately following disaster. The service is based on the acquisition, processing and analysis, in rapid mode, of satellite imagery and other geospatial raster and vector data sources, and social media when relevant. A Rapid Mapping activation is defined by one event and a location. There can be more than one area of interest (AOI) in an activation but these need to be linked to the same event. AOIs represent the geographical areas to be analysed and mapped. There can be more than one product per AOI [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the STAC catalog climate-risk-stac (https://climate-risk-data.github.io/climate-risk-stac/)]

lineage.description: The Copernicus Emergency Management Service (CEMS) uses satellite imagery and other geospatial data to provide free of charge mapping service in cases of natural disasters, human-made emergency situations and humanitarian crises throughout the world. It covers the following hazards relevant for climate risk assessments: floods, severe storms, fires
